text: Every component type exposes a uniform API (e.g. GetImage) regardless of hardware brand
quote: Every camera component in Viam exposes the same GetImage() method regardless of brand. Same for motors, sensors, arms, and other components.

text: Registry supplies drivers for hardware so you don't have to write your own
quote: Viam’s Registry provides drivers for your hardware, so you don’t need to implement one yourself. Specify your hardware model and connection details in the config, and viam-server pulls the driver from the Registry and initializes it automat

text: Official SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript, and Flutter for control and client apps
quote: Write your control logic in Python or Go, get lower-level control with C++, or build a client application with Typescript or Flutter.

text: Built-in NAT traversal lets you reach any machine through firewalls with no port forwarding
quote: Built-in NAT traversal means you connect to any machine through firewalls and routers. No port forwarding, no networking configuration, no "it works on my machine" problems.

text: Write code locally and run it against real hardware, streaming camera/sensor data live in the browser
quote: Write code in your local IDE and execute it against hardware in the field. Stream camera feeds, read sensor data, and visualize machine state in real-time from your browser.

text: Drive bases, move arms, and test components directly from the web interface without deploying code
quote: Drive bases with keyboard controls, move arms to specific positions, or test components directly from Viam's web interface. Debug without deploying code.

text: Data buffers locally during network outages/low bandwidth and syncs automatically when connectivity returns
quote: Data queues locally during network outages and in low-bandwidth environments, and syncs when connectivity returns. Viam handles restarts and storage constraints automatically.

text: Create and annotate datasets and train ML models via the cloud, or bring your own model
quote: Create and annotate datasets, and train ML models in your chosen architecture, all through the cloud. Or bring your own model.

text: Trained models are pushed to the cloud, pulled by machines automatically, and can be versioned/staged/rolled back
quote: Push trained models to the cloud. Machines pull them automatically and run inference locally. Version, stage, and roll back models just like code.

text: Fleet management provides remote monitoring of all machines
quote: Fleet Management: Remote monitoring, access control, and OTA updates

text: Fleet management includes access control for machines
quote: Fleet Management: Remote monitoring, access control, and OTA updates

text: CLI supports querying tabular data with SQL and exporting results
quote: viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query> [--destination=<output path>]

text: An AI agent using a shell or SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a human or program can
quote: An AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a person or a program can.

text: CLI can invoke any API method a machine serves, taking JSON in and returning JSON out
quote: The CLI can call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out.

text: Motion service plans and executes collision-free paths using a declared frame system and obstacles
quote: Viam's motion service plans a collision-free path and executes it, using a frame system you describe and obstacles you declare.

text: Connect a first machine to the platform to configure, control, and monitor it remotely
quote: Connect your first machine to the Viam platform so you can configure, control, and monitor it from anywhere. You'll create a machine in the Viam app, install Viam on your compute device, and confirm it's online.

text: Once a custom driver module exists, the hardware gets data capture, test panels, and SDK support automatically
quote: Once it exists, the hardware behaves like any built-in component. Data capture, test panels, and the SDKs work automatically.

text: Logic modules can react to sensor thresholds, coordinate multiple components, run continuous processes, and schedule actions
quote: Use a logic module when you need your machine to: React to sensor data... Coordinate multiple components... Run continuous processes... Schedule actions

text: Inline modules let you write code in the app's browser editor; Viam handles source, builds, versioning, and deployment
quote: Inline modules let you write code directly in the Viam app's browser-based editor. Viam manages source code, builds, versioning, and deployment.

text: Manage organizations, locations, machines, and permissions/authorization from one place
quote: With it you can create and manage organizations, locations, and individual machines, manage permissions and authorization, create and manage fragments

text: Fragments let you create and manage shared configuration to push across machines
quote: With it you can create and manage organizations, locations, and individual machines, manage permissions and authorization, create and manage fragments

text: Query tabular or binary robot data using SQL or MQL
quote: With it, you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data, add or remove tags from all data that matches a given filter

text: Export collected data in a variety of open formats
quote: With it, you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data, add or remove tags from all data that matches a given filter

text: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting across the whole fleet
quote: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting; OTA updates for software and ML models; Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning

text: Over-the-air updates for both software and ML models
quote: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting; OTA updates for software and ML models; Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning

text: Canary testing and rollback support for safe version rollout
quote: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting; OTA updates for software and ML models; Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning

text: Modular components can be pre-built or written from scratch in any language
quote: Modular Components: Pre-built modules or build your own in any language

text: List machine resources and their live status; unhealthy/configuring resources report why calls fail
quote: List the resources (`ResourceNames`) and their state (`GetMachineStatus`). A resource that is still configuring or unhealthy will fail every call; the status says why.

text: Search the registry for a driver model matching your hardware by manufacturer or type
quote: Search for the model that matches your hardware. Search by manufacturer or hardware type (for example, `webcam`, `viam:raspberry-pi:rpi5`, `viam:ufactory:xArm6`).

text: Compute and inspect a motion trajectory before the arm actually moves, via the motion planning API
quote: Use armplanning.PlanMotion to compute and inspect a trajectory before the arm moves, and learn how to get the same plan over the motion service API.
